Mode: BUILDER + play-tester (Round 70 of the experiment loop; base = merged main 70af7f0 — the Casey gate opened since R69, #85/#87/#88 all landed).

**Built (R69 spec item 3, [S], 2nd carrying, first build):** the loaded coev file's name now survives Train — recorded at load, printed in the C1 stats template until another load replaces it. R69 P4 verbatim-measured the wound (filename gone the moment Train overwrites the banner); the R70 pin reproduced it FAIL-first at the pristine tip in one run.

**Caught by this round's own play of the fix:** the artifact lane (loadCoev) served a stale player-file provenance after an artifact load (verbatim: file A's name printed at gen 121). Closed — the checkpoint's identity is its own receipted banner, never a player file.

**Pins:** tests/r70-coev-file-provenance-persist-glue.test.js — 5 tests (PERSISTENCE / REPLACEMENT / NO-FILE HONESTY / MALFORMED-IMMUNITY / ARTIFACT-BOUNDARY). FAIL-first recorded: T1/T2 2/2 RED on pristine tip; T5 RED with only the load-branch fix.

**Verified by running:** prerun canonical line byte-exact @ tip (coev.js 946e639a…, 5 flips / 3 swaps); v0.64.0/v0.65.0 byte-exact; v1 draw #6 = 3223/6114/2383 (six-draw spread L1 713–6500); suite 306 tests, 298 pass / 0 fail / 8 skips; test-qa 8/8; PLAYLOG marker grep EMPTY. README count 309→314 (run-verified). R55 prefix contract byte-intact (r61/r65 pins green).

**R71 spec in PLAYLOG:** 4 carried (franken tail [M] 6th carrying confirmed present-tense; lineage disclosure 5th; R1 annotation 4th; σ→trail 2nd) + 1 new (coev-file lineage chain).
title: Round 70: file-provenance persistence on the C1 lane (R69 spec item 3)
